summary: Targeted retest of the 6 iteration_3 fixes plus a quick regression check. All 6 fixes pass. Backend: test_iter4_fixes.py 4/4, test_gala.py 19/19, test_iter3_public.py 16/16 (was 14/16). Frontend: footer and countdown are translated in FR, EN, JA and ZH. Billetterie step 1 shows the EN titles Stand/Side/Premium with no price, and step 2 shows the translated title with a 50.00 EUR total. No em-dash on home (scrolled), /prix (all 7 modals, FR and EN), /mecenat, the footer, or /api/public/prizes, /config and /event.

issues: The grid uses lg:grid-cols-4 but only 3 tier cards render, so the 4th column is an empty grey cell (bg-ivoire/10 gap background) on the right. Use lg:grid-cols-3 (Billetterie.jsx ~l.57).

The FR nav is too wide: the logo 'Cook & Food' and 'GALA · 2026' wrap onto 3-4 lines, 'LES 7 PRIX' wraps onto 2 lines, and 'CASTING' touches the CONFIRMER button. EN fits on one line. Reduce the tracking/gap or add whitespace-nowrap.

The copyright / 'POWERED BY Factory Maker Studio' bar is full-bleed (starts at x≈40px) while the footer columns use the centered container (x≈250px), so they are misaligned. The 'POWERED BY' badge also stays in English in every language. Minor, likely intentional branding.

action_items: Billetterie.jsx: change the tier grid to lg:grid-cols-3 to remove the empty 4th cell
PublicLayout header: stop the FR nav and logo wrapping at 1920px (whitespace-nowrap, smaller gap)
Optional: align the footer bottom bar with the container
critical_code_review_comments: The login brute-force lock is now keyed on email only. This is correct for the bypass, but anyone can lock out a known staff email (including the admin) for 15 minutes with 5 bad attempts. Consider an additional ip:email counter or a CAPTCHA, or an admin unlock.
test_credentials.md still says 'par ip:email'. Update it to 'par email'.
seed_data_creation: None. The fake brute-force email login_attempts row is cleaned up in the test finally block.
